steam.name: Steam
setup: Steam Direct fee ($100 per app, recouped after $1,000 adjusted gross revenue)

itch.name: itch.io
setup: Page as Draft, then Public or Public restricted
itch.notes: Free to use with open revenue sharing. No review gate, so timing is up to you.

epic.name: Epic Games Store
setup: $100 submission fee per product, recouped after $1,000 revenue
epic.notes: Epic suggests publishing the product page at your announcement for early awareness.

switch.name: Nintendo Switch
setup: Register on the Nintendo Developer Portal
switch.notes: Program terms and certification steps are under NDA. Enter your own dates.

playstation.name: PlayStation
playstation.notes: Program terms and certification steps are under NDA. Enter your own dates.

xbox.name: Xbox
setup: Apply to ID@Xbox (18 or older or a parent or guardian, an NDA, and a country Microsoft does business with)
xbox.notes: Certification steps are shared after you join. Enter your own dates.

ios.name: iOS App Store
ios.notes: Pre-orders: release 2 to 180 days after the pre-order is published for a new app.

android.name: Google Play
setup: Testing requirements for new personal accounts
android.notes: Pre-registration lasts at most 90 days; up to two apps at a time.

web.name: Web browser
setup: A page that loads fast and works on phones
web.notes: No store gates. Treat your own page or itch.io page as home base.
